characters.arcThesis: From self-centered industrialist to selfless savior willing to sacrifice everything for others

milestones.keyMoment: Shrapnel embedded near heart; captured in Afghanistan
milestones.description: Tony Stark's convoy is ambushed in Afghanistan. A shrapnel fragment lodges near his heart, forcing him into captivity and moral reckoning.

milestones.keyMoment: Builds Mark I armor in cave; escapes
milestones.description: Using found materials, Tony engineers an escape route through the Mark I armor, combining engineering with purpose for the first time.

milestones.keyMoment: Confronts Obadiah Stane; nearly dies
milestones.tagline: The first battle with his own creation
milestones.description: Tony realizes Stane has been arming terrorists with his weapons. He confronts his former mentor in a desperate final battle in the Mark II armor.

milestones.keyMoment: Weaponizes suit further; ignores warnings
milestones.description: With no peer to challenge him, Tony grows increasingly arrogant. He creates more weapons-focused armor designs and ignores Pepper's concerns.

milestones.keyMoment: Palladium poisoning ravages his body
milestones.description: The arc reactor technology slowly poisons Tony. He faces his mortality and realizes his pride has made him enemies who want him dead.

milestones.keyMoment: Discovers new element; reconciles with Pepper
milestones.description: Tony uses his father's hidden blueprints to synthesize a new element, curing himself. More importantly, he lets Pepper guide him emotionally.

milestones.keyMoment: Clashes with Captain America and Thor
milestones.tagline: A superhero who doesn't play well with others
milestones.description: Tony resists joining a team effort. He sees the Avengers initiative as beneath him and needlessly risks lives with his independent approach.

milestones.keyMoment: Pilots nuke through portal; nearly dies
milestones.description: When all seems lost, Tony takes the nuclear missile through the portal, risking his life to save New York. He fades into space, truly alone.

milestones.keyMoment: Wakes to find the Avengers saved him
milestones.tagline: He finally understands what it means to be part of something
milestones.description: Tony realizes he was saved by his new team. The egoist is now part of a family, and the realization changes him fundamentally.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands with the team; quips and unity
milestones.tagline: The billionaire who learned to care
milestones.description: Tony stands shoulder to shoulder with Earth's mightiest heroes, no longer the lone wolf but a vital part of the collective defense of Earth.

characters.arcThesis: From frozen relic to modern leader who must balance old ideals with new realities

milestones.keyMoment: Becomes super soldier; proves himself in combat
milestones.tagline: A weak body gains a strong purpose
milestones.description: Steve Rogers, rejected repeatedly for military service, finally transforms through Dr. Erskine's serum. His small stature becomes irrelevant; his character is everything.

milestones.keyMoment: Dr. Erskine is killed moments after transformation
milestones.description: Steve loses his creator and mentor immediately after gaining his power. The serum dies with Erskine, making Steve the only one of his kind.

milestones.keyMoment: Used for propaganda instead of combat
milestones.tagline: A soldier reduced to a mascot
milestones.description: Rather than fighting, Steve tours as a propaganda tool. He chafes under the assignment, desperate to contribute to the war effort properly.

milestones.keyMoment: Finally leads troops in real combat; rescues prisoners
milestones.tagline: A soldier finds his true mission
milestones.description: Steve commandeers a mission and successfully rescues imprisoned soldiers, proving himself as both soldier and leader in one decisive action.

milestones.keyMoment: Dances with Peggy Carter; plans a future
milestones.tagline: A moment of normalcy amidst war
milestones.description: Steve and Peggy share a intimate dance, and he promises to return. For a moment, the soldier remembers he's a man with hopes and dreams.

milestones.keyMoment: Pursues Red Skull into space; crash lands
milestones.description: Steve fights Red Skull aboard an airship. To save the world, he crash-lands the plane in the Arctic. Peggy hears his dying words over the radio.

milestones.keyMoment: Wakes in 2012 New York, lost 70 years
milestones.description: Steve awakens in a world transformed. Peggy is an old woman. Allies he knew are gone. He must learn to fight for a future he doesn't understand.

milestones.keyMoment: Clashes with Tony Stark over strategy
milestones.description: Steve's straightforward military approach conflicts with Tony's technological showboating. They struggle to find common ground in their very different leadership styles.

milestones.keyMoment: Takes charge during final battle; coordinates team
milestones.tagline: The best soldier becomes the best leader
milestones.description: During the final invasion, Steve proves his military training translates to superhero tactics. He coordinates the team with precision and moral clarity.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands ready for the next threat
milestones.tagline: A man from another era finds his place
milestones.description: Steve accepts his new role as an Avenger. Though displaced in time, he has found a family and a purpose that transcends any era.

characters.arcThesis: From arrogant warrior prince to humble defender willing to sacrifice his throne for love and duty

milestones.keyMoment: Prepares for coronation; disobeys Odin's command
milestones.tagline: A prince too full of himself
milestones.description: Thor eagerly anticipates his coronation as King of Asgard. When frost giants infiltrate the coronation chamber, he recklessly pursues them to Jotunheim against Odin's explicit orders.

milestones.keyMoment: Fights frost giants; causes diplomatic crisis
milestones.description: Thor's reckless assault on Jotunheim destabilizes the Nine Realms. His arrogance risks war and violates the ancient Asgardian-Giant peace accords.

milestones.keyMoment: Odin strips him of power and exiles him to Earth
milestones.description: Odin strips Thor of his powers, armor, and Mjolnir, casting him to Midgard. For the first time, the invincible prince is vulnerable and powerless.

milestones.keyMoment: Crash-lands in New Mexico; meets Jane Foster
milestones.description: Stranded on Earth without his powers, Thor meets Jane Foster. Through her, he begins to see humanity not as beneath him, but as worthy of respect.

milestones.keyMoment: Lives with humans; understands their fragility
milestones.tagline: A god learns what mortals face
milestones.description: Living among mortals without his godly advantages, Thor finally grasps the courage required to be human. He witnesses sacrifice and love in forms he'd never considered.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands before Mjolnir; realizes his unworthiness
milestones.description: Thor attempts to lift Mjolnir and fails. The hammer won't yield to a god consumed by pride, no matter his bloodline. He finally understands worthiness is earned through character.

milestones.keyMoment: Sacrifices himself to stop the Destroyer
milestones.description: Facing the Destroyer alone and powerless, Thor chooses to fight for Earth and Jane rather than save himself. He stands without his power, accepting death.

milestones.keyMoment: Mjolnir returns; he rises worthy
milestones.tagline: Worthiness is granted to the humble
milestones.description: Thor's act of selfless sacrifice makes him worthy again. Mjolnir flies to him, and his powers return. But he is not the arrogant prince who was banished.

milestones.keyMoment: Defeats the Destroyer; sacrifices bridge home to save Jotunheim
milestones.tagline: A king sacrifices to protect both realms
milestones.description: Thor defeats the Destroyer and, despite gaining access to Asgard, destroys the Bifrost to prevent Loki's invasion. He chooses Earth and Jane over his home.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands with Earth's Mightiest Heroes
milestones.tagline: A warrior with a cause beyond himself
milestones.description: Thor joins the Avengers, using his power not for glory but to protect the realm he's come to love. He's found a family beyond Asgard.

characters.arcThesis: From resentful outcast seeking approval to ambitious villain tasting power and responsibility

milestones.keyMoment: Secretly manipulates events to prevent Thor's coronation
milestones.description: Loki secretly arranges for frost giants to invade Asgard during Thor's coronation, knowing it will lead to Thor's exile. His long-held resentment finally finds expression.

milestones.keyMoment: Reveals himself as the traitor; confronts Odin
milestones.description: Loki reveals to Odin that he orchestrated Thor's exile. He seeks approval from his father, only to be devastated when Odin rejects him once more.

milestones.keyMoment: Discovers he's a frost giant; Odin enters Odin Sleep
milestones.tagline: Everything he believed is a lie
milestones.description: Loki learns he was adopted—he's actually a frost giant, the very race he's been taught to despise. His entire identity crumbles.

milestones.keyMoment: Attempts to destroy Jotunheim and kill Laufey
milestones.description: Loki vows to destroy Jotunheim and kill his biological father, seeking to eliminate any connection to his true heritage and prove himself to Asgard.

milestones.keyMoment: Falls into the void; is caught by Thanos
milestones.description: After his plan fails and Thor defeats him, Loki falls into the void, seemingly to his death. But he's caught by an unknown force—Thanos—who gives him purpose and power.

milestones.keyMoment: Returns with Mind Stone and Chitauri army
milestones.description: Loki returns to Earth with cosmic power, an alien army, and a purpose. For the first time, he has the means to conquer. He's no longer scheming in shadows.

milestones.keyMoment: Launches the Chitauri invasion on New York
milestones.description: Loki opens a portal and sends alien forces to conquer Earth. With the Mind Stone's power and an entire army at his command, he savors his newfound dominion.

milestones.keyMoment: Encounters Black Widow and Captain America; reveals his philosophy
milestones.description: Loki articulates his belief that humans are happiest in servitude, enslaved by a superior being. He's become a true villain, not just a schemer.

milestones.keyMoment: Confronted by Hulk; utterly humiliated
milestones.description: Loki encounters the Hulk and is brutally defeated, tossed around like a toy. His godly pride is utterly shattered by a mortal, however powerful.

milestones.keyMoment: Surrenders; taken prisoner by Asgard
milestones.description: Loki's invasion fails. The Avengers defeat him, and he's returned to Asgard in chains, his bid for conquest ended before it truly began.

characters.arcThesis: From lethal assassin seeking redemption to trusted hero proving her worth beyond her training

milestones.keyMoment: Infiltrates Stark Industries as a spy
milestones.tagline: A weapon dressed as an assistant
milestones.description: Black Widow is deployed to gather intelligence on Tony Stark, posing as his assistant Natalie Rushman. She's a perfect infiltrator, leaving no traces.

milestones.keyMoment: Defeats Happy Hogan; proves her combat prowess
milestones.description: When the moment arrives, Black Widow effortlessly subdues Happy Hogan, demonstrating that her role is far more than secretarial. She's a lethal operative.

milestones.keyMoment: Helps Stark; mission complete
milestones.tagline: She chooses to do the right thing
milestones.description: When the opportunity arises, Black Widow doesn't simply extract herself. She helps Stark and Pepper Potts, suggesting her allegiance may extend beyond S.H.I.E.L.D.

milestones.keyMoment: Interrogates Loki and tricks him into revealing his plan
milestones.tagline: Her past catches up with her
milestones.description: Natasha lets Loki taunt her about the 'red in her ledger', then turns it around: his gloating gives away that he means to unleash the Hulk on the Helicarrier.

milestones.keyMoment: Leads Barton back from mind control; sacrifices mission for him
milestones.tagline: She saves one of her own
milestones.description: When Loki uses the Mind Stone to control Hawkeye, Black Widow pursues him ruthlessly. She risks the mission to save her partner, proving people matter more than objectives.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands with Earth's Mightiest Heroes
milestones.tagline: She's finally part of something real
milestones.description: Black Widow takes her place among the Avengers, not as a spy or assassin, but as a trusted hero. She's earned acceptance through her courage and loyalty.

milestones.keyMoment: Closes the portal with the scepter
milestones.tagline: A hint of something beyond duty
milestones.description: On the roof of Stark Tower, Natasha uses Loki's scepter to shut down the Tesseract device and close the portal once Tony is through.

characters.arcThesis: From loyal soldier following orders to independent hero making his own moral choices

milestones.keyMoment: Watches Thor from a S.H.I.E.L.D. perch with his bow drawn
milestones.tagline: A cameo with orders to shoot
milestones.description: In Thor, S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Clint Barton watches Thor fight his way to Mjolnir from a high perch, bow drawn, waiting on Coulson's order to take the shot. It is his first MCU appearance.

milestones.keyMoment: Loki controls his mind with the Mind Stone
milestones.tagline: Even his will isn't his own
milestones.description: Loki uses the Mind Stone to enslave Hawkeye's mind. The proud, skilled operative is reduced to a puppet, helpless to resist the god's power.

milestones.keyMoment: Fought as enemy; Black Widow frees him
milestones.tagline: Saved by those he would have killed
milestones.description: While under mind control, Hawkeye fights the Avengers. Black Widow breaks Loki's hold on him, risking herself to save her partner.

milestones.keyMoment: Fights back against Loki's forces
milestones.tagline: He takes back his own agency
milestones.description: Freed from mind control, Hawkeye channels his fury into the fight. His skill, no longer bent to evil, becomes a force for good.

milestones.keyMoment: Provides covering fire; saves civilians
milestones.description: Throughout the final battle, Hawkeye uses his precision to protect civilians and teammates, using his lethal training for protection rather than destruction.

milestones.keyMoment: Takes his place on the Avengers team
milestones.tagline: From Fury's tool to Earth's defender
milestones.description: Hawkeye joins the Avengers not as a soldier awaiting orders, but as an equal hero. He's transitioned from an asset to an actual team member.

characters.arcThesis: From scientist afraid of his own power to hero learning to work with it toward noble ends

milestones.keyMoment: Hiding in a favela after years of running
milestones.description: Bruce Banner has spent years running, hiding from both the Hulk and those who would use him. He's found temporary refuge in Brazil, learning to control his transformations through meditation.

milestones.keyMoment: Attempts to reconnect with Betty Ross
milestones.description: Bruce risks contacting Betty, hoping they might have a future together. But his condition makes every moment dangerous, potentially putting her in harm's way.

milestones.keyMoment: The Hulk saves Betty; his true strength emerges
milestones.description: When Betty is in danger, the Hulk emerges to protect her. For the first time, Bruce sees his power not purely as a curse—it saved her life.

milestones.keyMoment: Forced to fight Abomination; unleashes Hulk fully
milestones.description: When Emil Blonsky becomes the Abomination, Bruce realizes he must fully embrace the Hulk's power to protect those he loves. For the first time, he doesn't hold back.

milestones.keyMoment: Defeats the Abomination; loses Betty
milestones.tagline: To save her, he must leave her
milestones.description: Bruce wins his battle but loses his hope. He destroys the Abomination but must abandon Betty, disappearing into exile once more for her safety.

milestones.keyMoment: Approached by Fury; initially refuses to help
milestones.tagline: A broken man asked to help
milestones.description: Nick Fury recruits Bruce to help locate the Tesseract, but Bruce is terrified. He fears what will happen if he transforms, and he's unsure his anger can be controlled.

milestones.keyMoment: Loki's attack on the Helicarrier triggers the Hulk
milestones.description: When Loki's forces attack the Helicarrier, an explosion throws Bruce and Natasha below deck and the Hulk breaks loose, just as Loki planned.

milestones.keyMoment: Stops trying to control the Hulk; they finally work together
milestones.description: In the climactic battle, Bruce stops fighting the Hulk's nature. Instead of resisting, he channels the Hulk's power toward heroic ends, and they become unstoppable.

milestones.keyMoment: Stands with the Avengers; Hulk and Banner aligned
milestones.description: Bruce joins the Avengers not despite his curse, but as part of it. He's finally made peace with the Hulk, understanding that both sides have value.

characters.firstNote: played by Edward Norton; Mark Ruffalo took over in The Avengers

characters.arcThesis: From shadowy spymaster to visionary leader building Earth's mightiest defense

milestones.keyMoment: Approaches Tony Stark in secret; hints at larger initiative
milestones.tagline: A plan begins to take shape
milestones.description: Nick Fury meets Tony Stark after his emergence as Iron Man, hinting at a larger initiative. Fury is already thinking beyond individual heroes toward a team.

milestones.keyMoment: Gives Stark a plan to save himself; continues assembling
milestones.description: Fury helps Stark find the path to survival, but he's also recruiting Black Widow and Hawkeye. He's orchestrating something much larger than any one hero.

milestones.keyMoment: Leads S.H.I.E.L.D.'s study of the Tesseract
milestones.description: Fury recognizes that the Tesseract represents a threat from beyond Earth. His vision expands—Earth needs a defense against cosmic threats, not just terrestrial ones.

milestones.keyMoment: Discovers Captain America frozen in ice
milestones.tagline: The soldier who can unite them
milestones.description: Fury finds Steve Rogers, the perfect moral center for his Avengers team. He sees in Captain America the leader who can unite the powered individuals he's gathered.

milestones.keyMoment: Brings the Avengers together for the first time
milestones.description: Fury finally assembles the team he's been building toward. He's brought together heroes with wildly different personalities and powers, and he believes they can work together.

milestones.keyMoment: Watches the Avengers save New York
milestones.description: As the Avengers defeat Loki and his alien army, Fury's vision is proven correct. Earth has a defense force worthy of the threats it faces.

characters.arcThesis: From assistant to CEO to the human heart that keeps Iron Man grounded

milestones.keyMoment: Serves as Tony's personal assistant; tolerates his behavior
milestones.description: Pepper Potts manages Tony Stark's chaotic life as his assistant. She's intelligent and capable, but in a supporting role. She tolerates his arrogance because she believes in him.

milestones.keyMoment: Becomes CEO of Stark Industries
milestones.description: Pepper is promoted to CEO of Stark Industries. She's not content to stay in the shadows—she takes control of the company and its destiny.

milestones.keyMoment: Fights to save Tony as he faces palladium poisoning
milestones.description: While Tony drowns in arrogance and self-destruction, Pepper stands by him, trying to reach the man beneath the suit. She's the only one who sees his vulnerability.

milestones.keyMoment: Misses Tony's call as he flies the nuke into the portal
milestones.description: While Tony carries the nuclear missile toward the portal, he tries to call Pepper. She is watching the news and does not hear her phone in time.

characters.arcThesis: From boxer-turned-bodyguard to loyal friend and unexpected hero

milestones.keyMoment: Serves as Tony's bodyguard; provides grounded support
milestones.description: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, a former boxer providing physical protection and unwavering loyalty. He's gruff but genuinely cares about Tony's welfare.

milestones.keyMoment: Drives Natasha and Pepper to the Stark Expo
milestones.description: Happy drives Natasha and Pepper to Hammer Industries, then struggles with a single guard while Natasha takes down the rest of the hallway in seconds.

characters.arcThesis: A warlord convinced that wiping out half of all life is mercy, who gets exactly what he wanted and then loses it

milestones.keyMoment: Revealed as the power behind the Chitauri invasion
milestones.description: In the mid-credits scene, Thanos's servant tells him that attacking Earth means 'to court death'. Thanos turns and smiles.

milestones.keyMoment: Sacrifices Gamora on Vormir for the Soul Stone
milestones.description: Thanos throws his adopted daughter Gamora from the cliff on Vormir, because the Soul Stone demands the loss of someone he loves.

milestones.keyMoment: Snaps his fingers and erases half of all life
milestones.description: Wearing the completed gauntlet, Thanos snaps. Half of all living things turn to dust, and he retires to a farm to watch 'the sunrise on a grateful universe'.

milestones.keyMoment: Turned to dust by Tony Stark's snap
milestones.description: An earlier Thanos follows the Avengers to 2023. He snaps, but nothing happens: Tony has taken the stones. Tony snaps instead, and Thanos and his army turn to dust.

characters.firstNote: mid-credits scene, played by Damion Poitier; Josh Brolin from Guardians of the Galaxy (2014)

characters.arcThesis: A kid from Queens who wants to be an Avenger, then learns what it costs

milestones.keyMoment: Recruited by Tony Stark for the airport fight
milestones.tagline: A new suit from Mr. Stark
milestones.description: Tony visits Peter in Queens, gives him an upgraded suit and brings him to Germany to fight on his side at the airport.

milestones.keyMoment: Lifts the collapsed building off himself without the Stark suit
milestones.description: Tony took the suit back after the ferry disaster. Trapped under rubble in his homemade suit, Peter lifts the building and goes on to stop the Vulture.

milestones.keyMoment: Turns to dust in Tony's arms on Titan
milestones.description: After Thanos snaps, Peter tells Tony he doesn't feel so good, holds on to him and fades away.

milestones.keyMoment: Returns through a portal and is with Tony when he dies
milestones.description: Back from the snap, Peter hugs Tony in the middle of the battle. After Tony's snap he kneels beside him and says 'We won, Mr. Stark.'

characters.arcThesis: Tony's best friend and the military's man in the suit, always a step from the spotlight

milestones.keyMoment: Eyes the silver armor: "Next time, baby"
milestones.description: In Tony's workshop, Rhodey (played then by Terrence Howard) looks at a spare armor and says 'Next time, baby.'

milestones.keyMoment: Takes the Mark II armor after Tony's birthday party
milestones.description: After a drunk Tony endangers his party guests, Rhodey suits up in the Mark II, fights him and flies the armor to the Air Force, where it becomes War Machine.

milestones.keyMoment: Rebranded as the Iron Patriot
milestones.description: The government repaints the War Machine armor as the Iron Patriot, and Rhodey hunts for the Mandarin under that name.

milestones.keyMoment: Travels to 2014 Morag with Nebula for the Power Stone
milestones.description: In the time heist, Rhodey and Nebula go to Morag in 2014. They take the Power Stone before Peter Quill can.

characters.firstNote: played by Terrence Howard; Don Cheadle from Iron Man 2

characters.arcThesis: A pilot who learns her power was always her own, then carries it into the fight for half the universe

milestones.keyMoment: Breaks the Supreme Intelligence's hold and unlocks her full power
milestones.description: Carol remembers she is a human Air Force pilot, pulls out the Kree implant and fights at full strength for the first time.

milestones.keyMoment: Rescues Tony and Nebula from deep space
milestones.description: Tony and Nebula are adrift on the Benatar with no air left. Carol finds the ship and carries it home to Earth.

milestones.keyMoment: Destroys Thanos's warship and carries the gauntlet
milestones.description: Carol arrives in the final battle, flies straight through Thanos's warship and takes over carrying the gauntlet.

characters.arcThesis: An arrogant surgeon who learns to bet everything on the one future that works

milestones.keyMoment: A car crash wrecks his hands
milestones.description: Speeding while on the phone, Stephen crashes his car. Nerve damage ends his career as a surgeon and sends him to Kamar-Taj looking for a cure.

milestones.keyMoment: Traps Dormammu in a time loop until he bargains
milestones.description: Strange uses the Time Stone to lock Dormammu in a loop, dying again and again until Dormammu agrees to leave Earth.

milestones.keyMoment: Sees 14,000,605 futures and finds one win
milestones.description: On Titan, Strange looks at 14,000,605 possible futures. The Avengers win in one. He later hands Thanos the Time Stone to spare Tony's life.

milestones.keyMoment: Holds up one finger to Tony in the final battle
milestones.description: Back from the snap, Strange opens the portals that bring the armies in. At the key moment he shows Tony one finger: this is the future that works.

characters.arcThesis: A king who turns from revenge and opens a hidden nation to the world

milestones.keyMoment: His father T'Chaka is killed in the Vienna bombing
milestones.description: A bomb at the Accords signing in Vienna kills King T'Chaka. T'Challa hunts Bucky, the man framed for it, then spares the real bomber, Zemo.

milestones.keyMoment: Defeats Killmonger and opens Wakanda to the world
milestones.description: After nearly losing his throne to Killmonger, T'Challa wins it back and announces at the United Nations that Wakanda will share its resources.

milestones.keyMoment: Leads the battle for Wakanda against Thanos's army
milestones.description: T'Challa leads Wakanda's army and the Avengers against Thanos's forces to protect Vision. He turns to dust after the snap.

milestones.keyMoment: Returns through a portal with Wakanda's army
milestones.description: T'Challa steps out of one of Strange's portals at the head of Wakanda's army and later carries the gauntlet through the battle.

characters.arcThesis: A girl made into a weapon whose power grows with every loss

milestones.keyMoment: Shown as one of Hydra's experiments
milestones.description: In the mid-credits scene, Baron Strucker shows off his 'miracles': Wanda and her brother Pietro, held in Hydra cells.

milestones.keyMoment: Her twin Pietro dies in Sokovia
milestones.description: Pietro is killed shielding Clint. Wanda feels it, leaves her post and tears Ultron's main body apart.

milestones.keyMoment: Destroys the Mind Stone, killing Vision; Thanos reverses it
milestones.description: Wanda destroys the Mind Stone in Vision's head. Thanos uses the Time Stone to undo it and takes the stone, killing Vision again.

milestones.keyMoment: Overpowers Thanos in the final battle
milestones.description: Wanda tears Thanos's armor apart. He has to order his ship to fire on his own army to get free of her.

characters.arcThesis: An ex-con who wants to be a good dad and ends up holding the key to undoing the snap

milestones.keyMoment: Hank Pym recruits him to wear the Ant-Man suit
milestones.description: Fresh out of prison, Scott breaks into Hank Pym's house. Pym meant for him to find the suit, and recruits him to steal the Yellowjacket suit.

milestones.keyMoment: Trapped in the Quantum Realm when the snap hits
milestones.description: In the mid-credits scene, Scott is in the Quantum Realm when Hank, Hope and Janet turn to dust. No one is left to bring him back.

milestones.keyMoment: Freed by a rat, he brings the idea of a time heist
milestones.description: A rat walks over the van's controls and frees Scott. Five years have passed for him in five hours, and he takes the idea of using the Quantum Realm to travel in time to the Avengers.

characters.arcThesis: Thanos's abused daughter, rebuilt piece by piece, who helps beat him

milestones.keyMoment: Serves Ronan as Thanos's adopted daughter
milestones.description: Nebula fights alongside Ronan against her adoptive sister Gamora, and blames Thanos for the parts of her body he replaced.

milestones.keyMoment: Reconciles with Gamora
milestones.description: After a vicious fight, Nebula tells Gamora she only ever wanted a sister. The two start to make peace.

milestones.keyMoment: Stranded in space with Tony Stark
milestones.description: Adrift on the Benatar, Nebula patches up the ship with Tony and learns to play paper football with him.

milestones.keyMoment: Shoots her past self to save Gamora and the others
milestones.description: Her 2014 self, working for Thanos, holds a gun on Gamora. Present-day Nebula kills her past self.

characters.arcThesis: Tony's mentor and business partner who wanted the company, and the armor, for himself

milestones.keyMoment: Is revealed to have paid the Ten Rings to kill Tony
milestones.description: Tony learns that Obadiah paid the Ten Rings to kill him in Afghanistan, and has been selling Stark weapons to them.

milestones.keyMoment: Pulls the arc reactor out of Tony's chest
milestones.description: Obadiah paralyzes Tony with a sonic device and takes the arc reactor from his chest to power his own suit.

milestones.keyMoment: Dies when Pepper overloads the arc reactor
milestones.description: Fighting Tony on the roof of Stark Industries in the Iron Monger suit, Obadiah falls into the giant arc reactor when Pepper overloads it.
